title: Exercises
description: Create an exercise from a scenario, assign seats to AI or humans, check readiness and launch.
cloneHint: A new exercise with the same scenario and settings, linked to the original (counterfactual or stability test).
aiModeHint: Only “Real model” proves that the AI works. Scripted and replay runs are labelled NO AI everywhere.
budgetHint: Leave empty for the server default. The exercise pauses when it is exhausted.
seatsHint: One seat per institution. A human seat gets a personal link; the AI agent of the seat is only used for takeover.
seatLinkHint: Send it to the player. The token is after “#” and never reaches the server logs.
launchHint: Mark the exercise ready first; launching freezes the configuration (snapshot).
